title: Score each key with a small learned network
brief: Write the additive scorer, the attention built on it, and the parameters that make it imitate a plain dot product.
hints: For every key at once, u = W1 @ query + keys @ W2.T has shape (T, h). W1 @ query has shape (h,) and is added to every row.
The scores are np.tanh(u) @ v, one number per key. W1 goes with the query and W2 with the keys; swapping them fails on a non-square case.
additive_attention is additive_scores followed by attend. The softmax and the blend are already written for you.
tanh(c * x) / c is close to x when c is small. So W1 = W2 = c * I turns each entry into c * x, and v = query / c undoes the shrink at the end.
